importRows.name: Gravfält vid Film
importRows.notes: Cluster interpretation: official route text says the route passes a larger grave field with about 50 Iron Age graves after road 290. Fornsök confirms route-adjacent RAÄ Film 9:1/L1943:3137 and Film 34:1/L1943:3351 as grave fields, with nearby off-route Film 10:1/L1943:3269 making the count plausible. Coordinate is an approximate cluster marker, not a single RAÄ object centroid; keep medium confidence.

importRows.name: Tältplats, Risön

importRows.name: Filmspången
importRows.notes: Named on-route foot bridge after road 290. Coordinate is the midpoint of the OSM bridge way on Upplandsleden and falls on the official Etapp 12 GPX. Nearby bird tower is mapped at 60.2254768, 17.9056429, about 9 m from the official GPX, and is treated as supporting context rather than a separate import.
